p1: Every time I checked the peephole in Room 6, the hallway was red.
Not dark. Red. And every few seconds, it flickered.
I drive trucks. I figured, broken exit sign.
At checkout, I asked the clerk, Frank, about the red light. He went pale.
Son, there's no light in that hallway.
Room 7's been empty for years. But he never left.
It was his eye. Pressed to the peephole. Blinking.
Three weeks later. A different motel.
I didn't check the peephole. I know what colour it is.
